name: First Light from Beam Neutrinos on an LAPPD in ANNIE

summary.plain: ANNIE reported the first use of a large-area picosecond photodetector in a running neutrino beam. It saw beam-correlated light flashes matching charged-current neutrino interactions, the first time such a fast sensor has detected neutrino-induced Cherenkov light.
summary.technical: Packaged ANNIE LAPPD (PAL): waterproof self-triggering module with fast waveform digitization and precision timing synchronised to the ANNIE subsystems; beam-correlated LAPPD frames consistent with CC interactions seen in multiple subsystems; long-term stability, timing synchronisation and event matching validated.

title: First Light from Beam Neutrinos on an LAPPD in ANNIE
why_it_matters: A step towards deploying fast photodetectors in future large neutrino and particle detectors.
